source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB TBD identity; OOB counterpart establishes the standard bounded IP/UDP/RMCP statistics read.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic pre-step requests configuration verification and log clearing.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED pending selector/counter schema and reset semantics.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB counterpart classifies bounded volatile statistics read as FULLY AUTOMATABLE.

original_test_intent: Read and decode IP, UDP and RMCP statistics for one approved BMC LAN channel as a time-bounded health snapshot without clearing counters or changing network state.
original_method: Use the standard supported statistics request with validated channel/selector, counter widths/endianness/wrap semantics and independent traffic-health correlation.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies channel, schema and traffic reference once; bounded reads need no action confirmation.
safety_requirements: Bound pages and redact network data

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative after the standard OOB read history is considered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected standard statistics reader with pinned IP/UDP/RMCP counter parser and reset detection.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a bounded timestamped counter set, validate selector/length/units/wrap, correlate independent traffic and health, and prove counters/logs were not reset.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a concrete non-mutating Review-layer read without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A snapshot does not validate long-term packet behavior or clear/reset functions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrap, stale pages or reset-on-read can corrupt diagnostic conclusions.

project_override_considerations: Vendor telemetry can substitute if it exposes equivalent counter groups, widths, freshness and non-reset proof.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master is TBD and asks to clear logs/counters-adjacent evidence; GPT V2 treats missing Project counter schema as permanent BLOCKED despite the standard OOB history.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The bounded read intent/command family is known; schema, selector and reference are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines counter integrity, wrap/reset handling and independent traffic correlation instead of accepting an opaque read.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a non-mutating diagnostic read once reset semantics are verified. Collection and parsing are deterministic with a pinned schema, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is appropriate.
